newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Rethabile buys 20 pct of Alcatel Altech.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Rethabile buys 20 pct of Alcatel Altech.

text.p: South African black empowerment group Rethabile Group (Pty) Ltd has agreed to acquire a 20 percent interest in Alcatel Altech Telecoms (Pty) Ltd for 125 million rand, the companies said on Friday.
Alcatel Altech is owned equally by Alcatel CIT of France and South Africa's Allied Technologies Ltd (Altech).

Alcatel and Altech will both sell 10 percent to Rethabile, each receiving in return 2.5 million rand in cash and cumulative redeemable participating preference shares in Rethabile Telecoms (Pty) Ltd worth 60 million rand.
Rethabile Telecoms is a new special purpose holding company owned 100 percent by Rethabile.
The companies said the aim was to implement the transaction on July 1, subject to shareholder approval.
